home.guideBrowseA: Public content is available without logging in. Choose one of three entry points based on how deeply you want to explore.
home.guideBrowsePoint1: Select WikiNB in the top navigation to explore the complete nested notebook.
home.guideBrowsePoint2: Use Recently updated below for a quick look at Kaine's latest topics.
home.guideBrowsePoint3: Read each note on its own, then follow related links to go deeper.
home.guideAiQ: How can I use Kainnne x Gemini?
home.guideAiA: It is a visitor AI assistant for understanding Kaine, grounded primarily in the public WikiNB.
home.guideAiPoint1: Verify your name and email to start a conversation.
home.guideAiPoint2: Ask about featured projects, capabilities, working style, or collaboration ideas.
home.guideAiPoint3: Answers stay concise and point to relevant notes when more context would help.
home.guideSourceQ: What is the difference between public browsing and private login?
home.guideSourceA: Visitors can read the public knowledge base and use Guest AI. Private login is only for Kaine's system maintenance.
home.guideSourcePoint1: Public pages are read-only and need no administrator account.
home.guideSourcePoint2: Private login provides note management, sync, and the Codex workspace.
home.guideSourcePoint3: To learn about Kaine, simply browse the Wiki or use Gemini.

gemini.chooseTitle: Get to know Kaine and how he could help
gemini.followupTitle: What would you like to explore next?
gemini.plainPreference: Use clear, professional English, around 70–120 words. Explain what Kaine could take responsibility for, a concrete result and how to start working together. Default to help with implementation, not self-study. Teach only when asked for instructions. Ground proposals in public skills; do not invent client results, packages or commitments.
gemini.entry.automation.title: Reduce repetitive administrative work
gemini.entry.automation.description: Explore Kaine’s help designing automation for data entry, spreadsheets and routine reports.
gemini.entry.automation.question: I want to reduce manual data entry, spreadsheet updates and routine reporting. What could Kaine assess and implement, what might the result be, and how could we start working together?
gemini.entry.website.title: Explore Kaine’s help with a personal or business website
gemini.entry.website.description: Organize your experience, work or services into a clear, well-designed website that is easy to share.
gemini.entry.website.question: I would like Kaine’s help designing a personal or business website that presents my experience, work or services clearly. What content, design and implementation could he handle, what could the result be, and how can I discuss my needs with him?
gemini.entry.about.title: Get to know Kaine and his expertise
gemini.entry.about.description: Explore how AI, process improvements and web design can help with real work.
gemini.entry.about.question: Introduce Kaine’s main skills and what he could help individuals or teams build. Explain concrete outcomes in automation, AI adoption and web design, then how to discuss working together. Avoid product names and technical acronyms.
gemini.next.documents.label: Documents and data
gemini.next.documents.question: If I ask Kaine to help with documents and data, what automation could he plan and implement? Explain a possible deliverable and the sample information he would need from me.
gemini.next.repetitive.label: Simplify routine tasks
gemini.next.repetitive.question: I would like Kaine’s help connecting my current tools to reduce repeated copying and pasting. What could he assess and implement, and what would we need to confirm before working together?
gemini.next.portfolio.label: Resume or portfolio
gemini.next.portfolio.question: How could Kaine help people understand my skills through a resume or portfolio website? What materials could I prepare?
gemini.next.services.label: Services or events
gemini.next.services.question: How would Kaine organize the content and design of a website introducing my services or an event? Please give a concrete example.
gemini.next.unsure.label: Explore practical examples
gemini.next.unsure.question: Based on Kaine’s public skills, give two possible collaboration scenarios for this direction. Explain his responsibilities and potential outcomes without presenting proposals as past client results.
gemini.next.examples.label: View related projects
gemini.next.examples.question: Which of Kaine’s completed public projects relate to what we just discussed? Explain their use and include links. Distinguish completed work from plans.
gemini.next.prepare.label: Discuss how to work together
gemini.next.prepare.question: I would like to discuss this need with Kaine. What could he take responsibility for? List the two or three most useful things to include in my email and provide his contact details. The actual scope needs to be agreed together.
gemini.entry.knowledge.title: Build a searchable work knowledge base
gemini.entry.knowledge.description: Explore Kaine’s help with document organization, search and AI answers so scattered work information is easier to use.
gemini.entry.knowledge.question: Our work information is scattered across documents and notes. How could Kaine help plan and build a knowledge base or AI question-answering interface? Explain his possible responsibilities, outcomes and how to start working together.
gemini.entry.learning.title: Integrate AI into existing work
gemini.entry.learning.description: Explore Kaine’s help planning, connecting and piloting AI around the work you already do.
gemini.entry.learning.question: I would like Kaine’s help integrating AI into my or my team’s existing work. Based on his public skills, what planning, implementation and pilot work could he take on? Give one possible outcome and explain how to discuss working together.
gemini.next.finding.label: Organize personal files and notes
gemini.next.finding.question: If I ask Kaine to improve how I find my own files and notes, what organization or system design could he handle? Give a possible result suited to a small implementation.
gemini.next.teamKnowledge.label: Build shared team knowledge
gemini.next.teamKnowledge.question: Team documents are scattered and colleagues keep asking the same questions. What knowledge-base or AI interface design and implementation could Kaine handle? Explain a possible result and access permissions to confirm together.
gemini.next.personalAi.label: Improve an individual workflow
gemini.next.personalAi.question: I would like Kaine’s help adding AI to a routine task. What design and implementation could he handle? Give a possible outcome and explain how to discuss it with him.
gemini.next.teamAi.label: Plan team AI adoption
gemini.next.teamAi.question: How could Kaine help a team assess needs, design workflows and pilot AI? Explain possible outcomes and how to start working together, with training as a supporting option if needed.
